description: Book a real appointment at Norm for the signed-in client. Creates a genuine booking in the studio calendar under the signed-in phone number; booking on someone else's behalf is not possible. `clientNote` passes a short note in the client's own words to the master and `addonIds` adds the chosen add-ons. The result may include one optional follow-up slot (`optionalNextStep`). Requires sign-in to Norm.

addonIds.description: Optional add-on ids (`addons[].id` from `find_slots`) the client chose. Each adds its price and minutes to the visit.

clientNote.description: Optional note for the master in the client's own words, e.g. what they would like done and what they have on now (old gel/hybrid on the nails, current hair colour).

customerName.description: The client's first name. Required for first-time clients.

stafferId.description: Preferred master id. Without it the booking goes to whoever is free at that time.

time.description: Start time, HH:MM (Warsaw time), one of the times returned by `find_slots`.

name: book_appointment
title: Book an appointment
